mu_name_from: MODEL_CROSS_SHIELD (MODEL_SHIELD + 21), loaded from Item/crosssheild.bmd, MU's spelling (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1121). Ours is Shield22 by the index-plus-one rule. Group 6 number 21 in OpenMU S6 Armors.cs:62.

stats.call_note: CreateShield(number, slot, skill, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, defenseRate, durability, levelRequirement, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, energyRequirement, vitalityRequirement, leadershipRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel, ragefighterClassLevel), openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Items/ArmorInitializerBase.cs:158.

why_this_one: The Dark Lord's own shield, beside Adamantine in the first batch of his missing gear (docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md; drop 70, lords only; Tersia 5 pays it at +5). The user, 2026-10-25: 'we need missing Dark lord items', 'do it'.
sheet_from: Data/Item: crossshield_body (128x256, violet plate with gilt and silver bands, mesh 0), gra (256x64, a grey ramp, mesh 1, already here from the Frost Mace) and crossshield_cross (64x128, a cyan glass cross, mesh 2), decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names.
material_note: The face is MU's paint: painted_steel with the cast grain, as Crimson Glory's.
chrome_from: The same arm draws mesh 1 (gra) only RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT | RENDER_CHROME, its V at -(WorldTime % 2000) * 0.0005: its own ramp at chrome coordinates, added, sliding a whole turn every two seconds (scrolls_per_second 0.5, the renderer's offset being minus the rate). Never solid: its islands are hidden. pipeline/chrome_sheets.py.
separate_meshes_why: Three meshes MU draws three ways: the body solid, the ramp as chrome, the cross added.
effects_note: Shine colour 30, (0.7, 0.3, 0.3) (ZzzObject.cpp:6686; src/game/shine.cpp), which MU lays on mesh 0 alone (:9136-9139). Held: four blue BITMAP_LIGHTs at 1.2 on bones 4-7 and six teal at 1.4 on 8-13, all at |sin(WorldTime*0.001)| + 0.1 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:8193-8222; fx/held_lights CrossShield).
rig_note: export-rig: fourteen bones, one still key. Kept, as the scepters' rigs are; the held lights read bones 4-13 at rest (fx/held_lights points()).
glow_note: RenderPartObjectBody's MODEL_CROSS_SHIELD arm (ZzzObject.cpp:7249-7256) draws mesh 2, the cross, only RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT: added, never solid (ZzzBMD.cpp:1534). A glow sheet leaves the bake and ships drawn added, which is that.
